name: Wiz: pull issues
description: Every 5 minutes, queries Wiz (GraphQL issuesV2) for open or in-progress issues created since the previous run and creates one pending alert per issue (source wiz, deduplicated on the issue id, severity from the Wiz severity).

params.label: Wiz API host
params.help: Your tenant's API endpoint host (Wiz > User settings > Tenant info > API Endpoint URL), without https:// and without /graphql.

secrets.name: WIZ_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Client id of a Wiz service account.

secrets.name: WIZ_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret of that service account.

setup:
## Wiz side
1. Settings > Access Management > Service Accounts > **Add Service Account**, type *Custom Integration (GraphQL API)*, scope **read:issues** (add project scoping if you want only some projects).
2. Copy the client id and secret into `WIZ_CLIENT_ID` and `WIZ_CLIENT_SECRET`, each allowed for `auth.app.wiz.io` and your API host (the token is requested from the first and used on the second).
3. `WIZ_API_HOST` = the API Endpoint URL host shown under User settings > Tenant info (e.g. `api.us17.app.wiz.io`).

## How it works
- Token: `POST https://auth.app.wiz.io/oauth/token` form `grant_type=client_credentials`, `audience=wiz-api`, client id and secret. Tenants on the legacy Cognito auth (`auth.wiz.io`, audience `beyond-api`) or Wiz for Gov (`auth.app.wiz.us`) must change `token_url`/`audience` in the `pull` step and the secrets' hosts.
- `POST https://<WIZ_API_HOST>/graphql` with the `issuesV2` query, `filterBy: {createdAt: {after: <since>}, status: [OPEN, IN_PROGRESS]}`, `first: 100`, `orderBy: {field: CREATED_AT, direction: ASC}`.
- One alert per issue: external id = issue `id`, title = `<rule name> on <resource name>`, severity CRITICAL critical, HIGH high, MEDIUM medium, LOW low, INFORMATIONAL info.
- GraphQL answers errors with HTTP 200 and an `errors` array: that also fails the run (`Wiz issues pull failed: HTTP 200 (GraphQL errors)`; the error text is not copied).

## Limits
- ponytail: one page per run: at most **100 issues per window** (oldest first); `pageInfo.endCursor` is not followed.
- Issues are pulled on creation only; later status changes in Wiz are not synced.

Docs: Wiz API documentation is behind the Wiz login (docs.wiz.io > Wiz API: *Using the Wiz API*, *Issues*). Endpoints, audience and the issuesV2 field names follow those pages and public integrations; verify against your tenant's GraphQL explorer before enabling.

body.query: query IssuesTable($filterBy: IssueFilters, $first: Int, $after: String, $orderBy: IssueOrder) { issues: issuesV2(filterBy: $filterBy, first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: $orderBy) { nodes { id type severity status createdAt updatedAt sourceRule { __typename ... on Control { id name } ... on CloudConfigurationRule { id name } ... on CloudEventRule { id name } } entitySnapshot { id type nativeType name cloudPlatform region subscriptionExternalId subscriptionName providerId } projects { id name } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

config.expression: steps.pull.output.status == 200 and steps.pull.output.body is mapping and not steps.pull.output.body.get('errors') and (steps.pull.output.body.get('data') or {}).get('issues') is mapping

config.message: Wiz issues pull failed: HTTP {{ steps.pull.output.status }}{{ ' (GraphQL errors)' if steps.pull.output.body is mapping and steps.pull.output.body.get('errors') else '' }}

config.title: {{ (loop.item.get('sourceRule') or {}).get('name') or loop.item.get('type') or 'Wiz issue' }} on {{ (loop.item.get('entitySnapshot') or {}).get('name') or 'unknown resource' }}
